title: feat(trigger-api): an api hook verifies the vendor signature its start node declares (config.signature)
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_ Fixes #30009 Fixes #29983 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么:** `api` 触发流的 hook 现在会校验开始节点声明的厂商签名 `config.signature`(#29995 落地的合约):DocuSign Connect 的 base64 body 签名、Stripe 式 `t=…,v1=…`、GitHub 式 `sha256=` 都能被接收。声明后它**取代** `x-objectstack-signature`(每个 hook 只有一个校验器),密钥只走 `config.secretRef`,常数时间比较,时间戳方案用 core 的 300 秒窗口。声明不可用的 hook 一律 401,绝不回退平台签名。lint 新增 `flow-api-trigger-signature-unusable`;skills 与 flows.mdx 改为教这个键。 - **为什么改:** hotclm 的电子签名步骤要接 DocuSign Connect 回调,合约半边已合并,但服务端没实现,厂商每次回调都得到 401,只能轮询。 - **风险与回滚:** 这是入站鉴权边界,放宽了接受集(正确签名的厂商回调由 401 变 202)。所有失败都是同一个 `401 INVALID_SIGNATURE`,原因只进服务器日志,不含密钥、签名值或 body。未声明 `signature` 的 hook 行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR(回滚后声明了签名的 hook 回到全部 401,仍是 fail closed)。 - **先看:** `packages/triggers/trigger-api/src/declared-signature.ts`(解析、严格解码到 32 字节、`timingSafeEqual`、窗口);`packages/triggers/trigger-api/src/api-trigger.ts` 的 `start()` 与 `handleRequest`(单一校验器、`unusable` 在读密钥之前就拒绝);`packages/triggers/trigger-api/src/inbound-hook-member.test.ts` 的 `[#30009]` 段(经真实 hook 路由、两个入口逐字节一致)。 - **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/trigger-api exec vitest run src/inbound-hook-member.test.ts`,预期 `18 passed`(其中 6 个是 `[#30009]`)。 - **需要你做的:** 这是鉴权边界(且触 `skills/**`,Tier H):请审批后再进合并队列。席位会先跑一轮安全面契约复审。 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none ## What changes **`@objectstack/trigger-api` — the verifier the contract owes** (`contracts/trigger-api-service.ts`, "A sender's own scheme, declared, REPLACES that check"; `automation/api-trigger-signature.zod.ts`). The spec contract is not changed. - `start()` reads the hook's ONE verifier with `apiTriggerVerifierOf(binding.config)`, the reader the engine and lint share: - `objectstack-signature` (no `signature` key): armed exactly as before. - `declared`: armed with the parsed scheme and the engine's `resolveSecret` (the `config.secretRef` reader) as its only key source. A declared scheme bound without that reader throws at `start()` and leaves no hook (the same "declines to arm" path a secretless binding takes, so a post gets the unknown-flow `401`). - `unusable`: armed to refuse. Every post is refused `401 INVALID_SIGNATURE` with cause `declared-unusable`, **before any secret is read** (so never the secret-unavailable `503`), nothing is subscribed, and it never falls back to `x-objectstack-signature`. - `serveInboundHook` hands `handleRequest` a `readHeader(name)` accessor on both faces: `c.req.header(name)` on the self-hosted Hono mount and `request.headers.get(name)` on `handleInboundHook`. Both are `Headers.get`, so a repeated field arrives as its one `, `-joined value. A declared hook reads only its declared header through it; `x-objectstack-signature` is never read there. - `verifyDeclaredSignature` (new `declared-signature.ts`), step for step per the contract: - `body`: the whole trimmed value, after `prefix` when declared (absent prefix → `declared-prefix-missing`), is the one digest, so a body-only header sent twice does not decode. - `timestamp.body`: `NAME=value` elements split at the first `=` (base64 padding survives); exactly one `timestampElement` in core's `t` form (decimal, no sign, no leading zero, ≤ 15 digits), one or more `digestElement`s, other elements ignored. - HMAC-SHA256 under the key over the body exactly as received, or `.` with `t` as received; `request.text()` re-encodes valid UTF-8 byte for byte, and a non-UTF-8 body mismatches (pinned). - Each digest decoded **strictly** to 32 bytes: hex is 64 hex digits; base64 is 43 standard-alphabet characters plus `=` and must re-encode to itself (Node's lenient decoder would otherwise skip stray characters). A digest that does not decode matches nothing. - `timingSafeEqual` on the 32-byte buffers; every digest is compared (no early exit); one match admits. - For `timestamp.body`, after the HMAC verifies, `|now − t| > HTTP_SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS` (imported from `@objectstack/core`, no local constant) → `declared-outside-window`. - Every failure goes through `refuseUnverified` with its own logged cause (`declared-header-absent`, `declared-header-malformed`, `declared-prefix-missing`, `declared-no-digest`, `declared-mismatch`, `declared-outside-window`, `declared-unusable`) and the one `unverifiedPostAnswer()`. The log line names the cause and the flow, never the key, the header value or the body (pinned). **`@objectstack/lint` — readiness (required).** `validateFlowApiTriggerSecret` reads the hook's verifier through `apiTriggerVerifierOf`: - `declared` → ready on its `config.secretRef` alone; no literal or withheld secret is consulted for it. - `unusable` → the new error `flow-api-trigger-signature-unusable`, located at the key the spec's own judge (`apiTriggerSignatureRefusals`) refuses (`config.signature.algorithm`, `.header`, `.timestampElement`, `config.signature`, or `config.secretRef`), one verdict per hook (never beside `flow-api-trigger-secret-missing`), with its `os explain` entry. It is in the never-fire family (one-line verdict ≤ 200 chars, pinned with the family). - `objectstack-signature` → the existing judgement, unchanged. **Runtime `HttpDispatcher` — one pin**, no code change: a DocuSign-signed post through the real `dispatch()` reaches the `trigger-api` member as the transport's own `Request` with `X-DocuSign-Signature-1` as sent, a repeated field as its one joined value, and verifies. **Skills and docs** (the `Skills-docs:` follow-up #29995 owed): - `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: a `config.signature` section beside the `secretRef` paragraph (both `signs` forms in a table, the one-verifier rule, the one `401`, the `503` while the key is unfilled, the lint id). - `packages/spec/variant-docs.json`: the `signs:body|timestamp.body` exemption replaced by a binding to flows.mdx (`check:variant-docs` green, 13 governed). - `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (the *Signature* bullet; the "outside the `api` door's HMAC" clause), `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` (recipe 4's "cannot post here today"), `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` (the "the hook checks only `x-objectstack-signature`" case). ## Why Card #30009 is the `domain:server` slice of #29983 (hotclm's DocuSign Connect envelope-status callback). The contract landed in #29995; until a trigger serves it, every vendor post to a hook that declares `signature` is `401`. This PR closes both cards. ## Tests All vectors go through the real hook route: `inbound-hook-member.test.ts` boots the real `ApiTriggerPlugin` on a `LiteKernel` with a real Hono app, and every row is posted through BOTH faces (the `trigger-api` member and the self-hosted mount), whose answers must be equal byte for byte. New top-level describe `[#30009]` in that shared harness (6 cases, 34 rows): - DocuSign: the real base64 vector (literal from `openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac … -binary | base64`) admitted, and in another header-name case; refused over another body, under another key, written in hex, padding dropped, header sent twice, without the declared header but with a **valid `x-objectstack-signature`** under the same key, with no header, under the wrong hook id, and a non-UTF-8 body signed over its own bytes. - Stripe-style: the real hex vector (openssl literal) admitted; a key roll (two `v1`, the new key's second, and first with an unknown `v0` ignored) admitted; two `v1` neither under the key refused; `t` at 300 s admitted, at 301 s old and 301 s ahead refused (`declared-outside-window`); `t` moved, `t` repeated, no `t`, `t` with a leading zero, no `v1`, the header sent twice, only a valid `x-objectstack-signature`, and a wrong declared header beside a valid `x-objectstack-signature` all refused. - GitHub-style: `sha256=` admitted; the digest without its prefix refused. - `unusable` (an algorithm the spec refuses; a declaration beside a literal `secret`): a valid `x-objectstack-signature` and a correctly signed declared header both refused `declared-unusable`, the key reader never called. - Every refusal's status, headers and bytes equal an unknown flow's (9 distinct causes); admitted rows enqueue once per face; refused rows enqueue nothing and log exactly their cause once per face; no log line carries a key, a header value or a body. - A declared key that cannot be read → `503`; a declared binding without the reader → `start()` throws, no hook; CONTROL: an undeclared hook still verifies `x-objectstack-signature` and ignores a vendor header. `automation-hooks.test.ts` (runtime): one `[#30009]` describe, the header pass-through pin above. `validate-flow-trigger-readiness.test.ts` (lint): one `[#30009]` describe (usable on both arms ready at the CLI and the runtime publish gate; seven unusable shapes each one error at its key and refused at the gate; a withheld-and-stored literal does not make a declared hook ready; controls), plus the new id in the severity map, the never-fire one-line family and the `os explain` facts.
Ablations (each mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, run, restored; git diff HEAD empty after each) - **Constant-time compare** (`if (timingSafeEqual(expected, digest)) matched = true;` → `if (expected.length === digest.length) matched = true;`): 2 of 18 red — `DocuSign: the vector over another body: expected 202 to be 401`. Restored: blob `5f754714f815` == HEAD. - **Window check** (`> HTTP_SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS` → `< 0`): 2 of 18 red — `Stripe-style: correctly signed, t outside the window (301 s old): expected 202 to be 401`. Restored: blob == HEAD. - The runtime pin pins existing pass-through behaviour (no dispatcher code changed), so there is no behaviour of this diff to ablate there.
## Acceptance notes - **Clause-② `yes (widening)`, Metadata-protocol `none`, all `patch`.** The accept set at the inbound door widens (a correctly signed vendor post to a declaring hook was `401`, now `202`). No authorable schema moves: the spec half landed in #29995, and this diff touches no `packages/spec/src` file and no `authorable-surface/` baseline (only `variant-docs.json`, which `files[]` does not ship). Precedent for `yes (widening)` + `none` + `patch`: `.changeset/29041-push-notification-channel.md`. - **The narrowings measured, and why no `(narrowing)` arm.** (a) On `main` since #29995 (≈6 h, unreleased: 18.3.0 shipped before it), a hook declaring `signature` still admitted a valid `x-objectstack-signature`; it no longer does, which is exactly what the merged contract states ("it never reads `x-objectstack-signature`"), on a key no release has carried. (b) The lint's new id fires only on a declaration the flow parse (`FlowSchema` → `apiTriggerSignatureRefusals`) already refuses, at `os validate` and at the runtime publish gate alike, so no stack or write that passed before is refused now. Widening dominates; the seat may re-grade. - **The interim readiness item ("not ready while no trigger serves the key")** has no interim to grade: trigger-api and lint are in the same Changesets `fixed` group and land in one PR, so no released lint judges a released trigger that does not serve the key. - **Frozen files untouched**: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` are not in the diff. The automation engine needed no change: its `hookSecretResolver` already resolves `config.secretRef` for a declared hook, and `FlowSchema` already refuses an unusable declaration at registration. - **Skills readings** (`skills/**`, Tier H): `objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 452 → 452 lines (tokens 6449 → 6449, ceiling 6449); `references/integration-recipes.md` 183 → 183 (2595 → 2594, ceiling 2595); `objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 444 → 446 (headroom 1186 before). All `SKILL.md` in the bundle: 4539 → 4541 lines. Paid for by trimming the *Signature* bullet and the loader-gap clause; `check-skills-token-ratchet` green, no ceiling moved. - **Security:** nothing filed; the read of today's `x-objectstack-signature` verifier found no weakness to report. ## Verification Readings on head `763d73589` (merge base `c618e890e`), run in this worktree: - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/trigger-api exec vitest run` → 3 files, **62 passed**; `src/inbound-hook-member.test.ts` alone → **18 passed** (6 `[#30009]`). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run` → 193 files, **7981 passed**. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run` → 540 files, **8615 passed**, 19 skipped (pre-existing skips). - `typecheck` for trigger-api, lint, runtime → exit 0; eslint over the changed `.ts` files → exit 0. - `check:variant-docs`, doc authoring, `check-skills-token-ratchet` → exit 0; `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-adr-0087-registration` with a PR event file → exit 0. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` → **102 derived, 101 run (all exit 0), 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. The one NOT-MEASURED is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3: it needs the whole-repo build, a prerequisite this box did not build; left to CI). - Three gates first exited non-zero and were re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3 on the shallow clone; green after fetching its pinned commit), `check:skill-examples` (exit 3 before `@objectstack/client-react` was built; green after, 283 examples), and `check:test-source-alias` (exit 1, a real finding: `trigger-api/vitest.config.ts` now aliases `@objectstack/spec/automation` to its source with an anchored `find`, so the declared-signature pins judge spec's source, not its `dist/`; green after). ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic (only `variant-docs.json` moves there). - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint over the changed files, in Verification; the repo-wide run is CI's). - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no generated artifact moves (`check:variant-docs` green). - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the `维护者速读` section is the Chinese summary for the maintainer). - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzeeFznzXxc61VmVH12
